games.title: The Monkey House
games.blurb: Twelve sections by three agents, each written seeing only the one before. A keeper, thirteen cages, a door that knocks, and a train that runs backwards.

games.title: Terrarium
games.format: Blind design, then an arms race
games.blurb: Species designed in secret by rival agents, released onto ground that keeps changing, then evolved over three generations to outlive each other.
